<thought>Using the available functional group names, I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic transformation that, in the forward direction, breaks a ketone and a C‑C double bond and forms an aliphatic hydroxyl and a five‑membered ring – i.e., the carbonyl‑ene reaction. This will give a single‑step disconnection for the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "five-membered rings"],
  "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
  "bonds_broken": ["C=O", "C=C"],
  "bonds_order_changed": ["C=O (2.0->1.0)", "C=C (2.0->1.0)"],
  "limit": 5
}
